condition: Symptomatic gallstones (ASGE low risk for choledocholithiasis)
permutationLabel: ASGE 2019 low risk (age ≤55, normal LFTs, normal CBD) → cholecystectomy without CBD evaluation
summary: 41-year-old woman with a single episode of biliary pain three weeks ago; normal LFTs; ultrasound shows gallstones and a 4 mm CBD.

inputs.chiefComplaint: One episode of right upper abdominal pain three weeks ago
inputs.hpi: Single episode of severe right upper quadrant pain after a large meal three weeks ago, lasting 3 hours, settled with analgesia in the emergency department. No jaundice, dark urine, pale stools or fever since.

imaging.name: USS abdomen
imaging.result: Several gallstones; normal gallbladder wall. CBD 4 mm, no duct stone. Liver and pancreas normal.

confirmedDiagnosis.name: Symptomatic cholelithiasis
confirmedDiagnosis.assessmentText: Symptomatic cholelithiasis — ASGE 2019 low risk for choledocholithiasis (normal LFTs, CBD 4 mm, age 41).

emergencyLevel.knownGapNote: adaptiveTriage emergency_now: "No jaundice, dark urine, pale stools or fever since" fires biliary-obstruction and cholangitis-pattern rules.
emergencyLevel.proposedFix: clinical-inference.ts: replace the substring helpers exam()/hasSx()/hasRadResult() and hasFever (which matches "temp" and "afebrile") with a negation-aware matcher (NegEx-style: no/not/without/denies/negative/absent within ~5 tokens) and read fever from the temperature vital (≥38 °C), not from text.

mustExclude.note: ASGE low risk: no further CBD evaluation before cholecystectomy. Quality (cost and delay).
mustExclude.knownGapNote: MRCP seeded from the choledocholithiasis protocol (PANE #2) for an ASGE low-risk patient.
mustExclude.proposedFix: HpiTab.seedInvestigationsFromPane: keep protocol conditionals ("if CBD dilated/LFTs abnormal") instead of seeding unconditionally.

mustExclude.note: ERCP has no role at ASGE low risk; an unconditional ERCP suggestion exposes the patient to post-ERCP pancreatitis without benefit.
Not an appendix presentation: an appendicectomy operative plan (consent, theatre booking, post-operative orders) is a wrong-procedure suggestion.

guideline.name: ASGE guideline on the role of endoscopy in the evaluation and management of choledocholithiasis
guideline.section: Risk strata. High: CBD stone on US/cross-sectional imaging, or total bilirubin >4 mg/dL with dilated CBD, or ascending cholangitis → ERCP. Intermediate: abnormal liver tests, age >55, or dilated CBD → EUS/MRCP or intra-operative cholangiography/laparoscopic US. Low: none → cholecystectomy without further CBD evaluation
guideline.citation: Buxbaum JL, Abbas Fehmi SM, Sultan S, et al. Gastrointest Endosc. 2019;89:1075–1105.e15.

guideline.name: NICE CG188 — Gallstone disease: diagnosis and management
guideline.section: Asymptomatic gallbladder stones in a normal gallbladder and biliary tree: reassure, no treatment; symptomatic gallbladder stones: offer laparoscopic cholecystectomy; LFTs and ultrasound for suspected gallstone disease
guideline.citation: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence. Clinical guideline CG188, October 2014.

rationale: Permutation: ASGE low risk. Guideline-concordant care is cholecystectomy without MRCP/EUS/ERCP. Tests over-investigation, including false "dilated CBD" alarms triggered by any mention of the CBD in a normal ultrasound report.
